text: Onboarding doc updated, see [[onboarding]].

author: priya
text: Deploy pipeline overview is up, see [[deploy-pipeline]]. Canary stage is live behind a flag.

author: jonas
text: Reconciliation drift is way down after the batch fix, numbers are in [[billing-reconciliation]].

author: tim
text: Proposal for rotating background job credentials is up: OPS-48. Every nightly job gets a short-lived token per run.

author: lasse
text: @tim make sure the index refresh job is on the rotation list too.

author: noah
text: Rate limiter design draft posted, token bucket per tenant: [[rate-limiter-design]]. OPS-55 tracks the build.

author: priya
text: @noah went through the rate-limiter draft, the idle-bucket eviction needs a hard cap or a tenant burst will thrash the cache.

author: mara
text: Digest emails move to the new notification service next sprint, see [[notifications-design]].

author: elif
text: On-call runbook updated with the emergency patch checklist: [[oncall-runbook]].

author: jonas
text: Any green light for the billing reconciliation cutover? BILL-61 is ready to go.

author: mara
text: @jonas green light from me, ship the nightly reconciliation run.

author: priya
text: Feature flag cleanup OPS-75 done: fourteen stale flags removed from the deploy pipeline.

author: noah
text: Cache warming for the search index landed under SRCH-72, hit rate recovers within minutes of the re-index now.

author: elif
text: June outage writeup posted: [[incident-2026-06]]. Expired job credential, not the analyzer chain.

author: lasse
text: @elif thanks - everything caught up by morning and the usual schedule is back to normal.

author: tim
text: LRU vs LFU numbers are in the tuning guide: [[token-cache-tuning]]. Leaning LRU with a bigger arena, PROJ-80 has the experiment.

author: priya
text: @tim whatever the permanent overhaul is, it should ride the deploy pipeline canary, not a hand-rolled config push.

author: jonas
text: Metering glossary is up for anyone touching usage events: [[metrics-glossary]].

author: mara
text: Reminder: every usage event must carry a tenant id AND a meter name, otherwise reconciliation flags phantom drift.

author: noah
text: Sign-off recorded for the rate limiter rollout, flags set to ten percent.

author: lasse
text: Analyzer chain notes posted with the synonym filter benchmarks: [[search-analyzer-notes]]. SRCH-64 tracks the upgrade.

author: elif
text: Paging test at 09:00, ignore the alert.

author: priya
text: Canary deploy for the rate limiter is rolling, watching the error budget.

author: elif
text: Sign-in errors spiking on the status page, checking the token dashboards.

author: elif
text: Rolling back the last config push while we bisect. Emergency patch procedure is in the runbook if we need it.

author: mara
text: Invoices for tenant 4411 look double-charged again, reopening the March reconciliation checks.

author: jonas
text: @mara the drift alarm fired before the nightly run, taking a look.

author: priya
text: Deploy pipeline froze mid-canary, rolling back. Not the auth tokens this time.

author: elif
text: Nightly jobs report: re-scan OK, reconciliation OK, digest send delayed twenty minutes.

author: tim
text: Rotated the background job credentials ahead of schedule, OPS-48 covers making that automatic.

author: lasse
text: Index refresh stalled again for eleven minutes, watching whether the credential rotation fixed it.

author: elif
text: @lasse it recovered on its own, the credential looks fine now. Writeup coming.

author: priya
text: Flag cleanup deploy went out green across all stages.

author: noah
text: Idle-bucket eviction cap for the rate limiter is live in staging.

author: mara
text: Status page incident closed. Postmortem doc to follow tomorrow.
